purpose: Which provincial highways carry the Trans-Canada Highway, and over what stretch. Canada publishes no machine-readable register of the system, so this closed set is assembled by hand (DATA-SOURCES D-52). The routes are those Wikipedia's article lists, main route and every branch; the National Road Network's own segment names (CA-1) fix the extent wherever the province records them, and the stretches it does not name are bounded here by junction.

extent.named: the segments the NRN names Trans-Canada Highway (or Transcanadienne) on this route, with gaps under 10 km between them closed
extent.whole: the whole route; the NRN names none of it, and all of it is Trans-Canada
extent.between: the stretch of the route's mainline between two points, each a junction with another route (the closest approach of the two) or a coordinate
